test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ravi spends 20% of his income on petrol, one-third of the remaining income on household expenditure, and the balance is his savings. If he spends ₹7,500 on petrol, find his household expenditure.
solution:
**Given:**

Ravi spends 20% of his income on petrol.

One-third of the remaining income on household expenditure.

Balance is his savings.

He spends ₹7,500 on petrol.

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure on petrol / Percentage spent on petrol

Household expenditure = One-third of remaining income
